description: MORE SLICES & SCUFFS (conservative). On-disk hex edits of eFootball.exe. Raises how often mis-kick types fire (A/A2), how far they deviate (C/F 30deg, D 15deg floor), scuffed-power magnitude (B 40%) and error spread (E), and flattens the ability curve so even 90+ players mis-hit (G1/G2). Human AND CPU. All disp32 repoints to existing float cells; restore reverts byte-exact. Denuvo/Steam may reject a modified exe (crash/refuse to launch, no ban offline); if so run: python tools/exe_patch.py restore. See docs/exe-gameplay-map.md.
